name: dogfood-observability-chaos-aiops-app
description: Dogfood app v1.42-4 — a chaos engineering + AIOps observability harness driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa-lab/observability v2.2 advanced III semantics (chaos axis: injectFault + computeBlastRadius + triggerRollback + recordGameDay; aiops axis: detectAnomaly + executeRemediation + analyzeRootCause + correlateAlerts) + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 12-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the observability v2.2 chaos + aiops state machines deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter emits an LitmusChaos + Gremlin + PagerDuty AIOps style fault injection + anomaly + runbook API sequence through the KIWA_MODE=real testcontainers-driven stack when KIWA_CHAOS_ENGINE_URL / KIWA_AIOPS_API_URL / KIWA_RUNBOOK_URL are wired, and otherwise reports KIWA_CHAOS_AIOPS_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 lifecycle stages (chaos / remediation / rca) x 4 observability targets (grafana-oss / prometheus / loki / otel-collector) so behavioural drift between mock semantics and real chaos-engine + AIOps + runbook APIs stays observable and feeds the @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.
